answer: At every summit of the attestation season, the ledger issues unannounced liveness drills: each identity must sign a fresh challenge within minutes, proving one distinct live machine stands behind it. A farmer multiplexing a single GPU across timber rows of fake agents can only answer for one of them in time; the rest default and lose their uptime credit. A whispered appeal restores only identities with clean histories. Running a hundred puppets then costs a hundred real machines, and the economics of fakery collapse.
